total_cost_per_functional_unit.note: Material/energy costs per 1 kg cell (excludes labor, overhead, capital), at the default design.

design_parameters.title: Cell design — BatPaC (NMC95)
design_parameters.description: BatPaC sets every material amount for 1 kg of cell from these settings.

derived.n_bicells: packing_density * (cell_thickness_mm * 1000 - 2 * container_um - cu_foil_um) / (al_foil_um + cu_foil_um + 2 * (separator_um + cathode_thickness_um + anode_thickness_um))
derived.container_g: (2 * cell_width_mm + 2 * cell_thickness_mm + 2 * seal_width_mm) * (cell_length_mm - 2 * term_ext_length_mm) * container_um / 1000 * rho_container / 1000
derived.electrolyte_g_cm2: (t_pos_cm * porosity + t_neg_cm * porosity_neg * neg_area_factor + separator_um * 1e-4 * separator_porosity * sep_area_factor) * rho_electrolyte
derived.unit_g_cm2: coat_pos_g_cm2 + coat_neg_g_cm2 * neg_area_factor + al_g_cm2 * al_area_factor + cu_g_cm2 * cu_area_factor + sep_g_cm2 * sep_area_factor + electrolyte_g_cm2

sources.cite: Knehr, K. W., Kubal, J. J., Nelson, P. A., & Ahmed, S. (2022). Battery performance and cost modeling for electric-drive vehicles: A manual for BatPaC v5.0 (ANL/CSE-22/1). Argonne National Laboratory.
Argonne National Laboratory. (2024). BatPaC 5.2, version 2024-11-1 [Spreadsheet model].
sources.used_for: Material data, design defaults, prices, cell hardware

notes: The 80 µm default cathode thickness is LiTeCAB's choice.
Wh/kg reads about 2% high: no C/3 voltage loss or extra electrolyte.
Tabs, pouch and assembly energy follow ecoinvent's NMC811 cell.
Cost is materials and energy only.
